# Electric Food Waste Disposers — Company & Product Information

> B2B manufacturer: 义乌市飞浦星日用品有限公司. Brand presentation: Electric Food Waste Disposers.

## Company
- Company name as provided: 义乌市飞浦星日用品有限公司
- Brand name as provided (English spelling normalized for presentation): Electric Food Waste Disposers
- Website: https://electricfoodwaste.com/
- Business focus: global B2B, OEM/ODM and private-label discussions for dry heat-based kitchen food waste reduction appliances.
- Contact: add verified sales email and phone before launch.

## Product scope
- Product process supplied by company: heating/drying and volume reduction.
- Do not claim grinding, composting, sterilization, odor elimination, processing time, capacity, energy use, noise level, MOQ, lead time or certifications unless the company verifies and publishes the data.
